_purpose: Per-school shortlist of the HESA/CAH disciplines a human most commonly picks for cxp-01_subject's 'group' option (fork02-shell), so choosing a school offers a top 5-10 instead of the full CAH tree. Built from cardiff_met_courses.csv (239 real courses, grouped by school) and verified against the live resolver chain (tools/subject/core/tools/resolve-subject-context.js -> tools/resolve-subject-benchmark.js -> catalogue/context/subject/benchmarks.json, 55 entries). Every code/label below was run through that resolver on 2 Nov 2026; nothing here is invented.
resolverNotes: matchQuality 'direct': the code/term resolves to exactly one catalogue benchmark via its own code or an unambiguous hecos/cah3 match. Safe to use as-is.

matchQuality 'umbrella': the code is a genuine CAH1/CAH2 whole-discipline grouping, but resolve-subject-benchmark.js returns benchmark: null (gap.type: no-benchmark) at this level - the discipline spans several distinct QAA benchmarks and the catalogue has no single entry for the umbrella itself. Fine as a scoping/display label; pick a narrower entry below it when an actual benchmark reference is needed.

matchQuality 'fallback-imprecise': the resolver returns a non-null benchmark, but only because an unrelated catalogue entry happens to declare the same CAH2 ancestor (e.g. nursing/midwifery/physiotherapy/podiatry all fall back to 'optometry-2024' purely because optometry's own codes[] lists CAH02-06 'allied health' as an ancestor and is first in the catalogue array). Do not present this match to a human as if it were a real subject-specific benchmark - treat it as unresolved.
catalogueGaps: No QAA benchmark entry exists yet in catalogue/context/subject/benchmarks.json for: sport and exercise science, nursing (any field), midwifery, physiotherapy, podiatry, speech and language therapy, dietetics, animation, photography, hotel management, TESOL, early years/early childhood. Terms in this file for those subjects are marked 'umbrella' or 'fallback-imprecise' rather than given a false direct match.
